description: The verdict linode_profile_can_run answers for every blocked category, pinned identically in every language. These reason and remedy sentences are declared on the operation as a per-verdict wording vocabulary, because a can_run reason is a member of a successful answer rather than a refusal that ends the call and two tools sharing the operation have to answer the same words; neither engine keeps a copy. The shared behavior fixtures cannot reach three of the four categories because that replay runs under full-access, which permits every tool in every environment. Each language builds the catalog and profile below, sends calls, and compares the whole answer to expect_result, so rewording one language's copy alone fails that language's suite instead of forking the words two binaries show for the same pre-check.

results.remedy: target an environment in the profile's allowed_environments, or switch to a profile that permits this environment
switch to a profile that permits linode_instance_create, or add it to the current profile
switch to a profile that permits linode_instance_delete, or use yolo on a profile that allows it
check spelling or call linode_profile_list_tools to discover the registered tool surface
